verdict.rationale: CDP documents conversion between USDC and USD through deposit destinations that act as liquidation addresses (auto-converting incoming funds before crediting the account) and a guide for auto-converting customer USDC to USD treasury. It also documents funding a USD treasury and paying out USDC, Onramp/Offramp, and transfers with upfront fee quotes. However, the evidence shows conversion as a side effect of deposits and payouts, not a standalone quote-then-execute conversion API, and gives no documented rates or settlement times. missing for 10: dedicated conversion quote/execute endpoints, documented conversion rates and spreads, documented settlement times, explicit stablecoin-to-stablecoin conversion (e.g. USDT↔USDC) in the custodial API, independent corroboration.
